note.en: Advanced Placement courses give university-level content, mainly in Grades 11-12; students pick AP courses at course selection and are assessed on AP content by a standardized exam each May. Markville lists AP Calculus, Chemistry, Microeconomics, European History, English and Geography (World Issues); students fill out an AP Application Form from Guidance.
note.es: Los cursos de Advanced Placement ofrecen contenido de nivel universitario, sobre todo en 11.º y 12.º grado; los estudiantes eligen los cursos AP en la selección de cursos y se evalúa el contenido AP con un examen estandarizado cada mayo. Markville ofrece AP Calculus, Chemistry, Microeconomics, European History, English y Geography (World Issues); los estudiantes completan un AP Application Form disponible en Orientación.
note.fr: Les cours Advanced Placement offrent un contenu de niveau universitaire, surtout en 11e et 12e année; tu choisis les cours AP lors du choix de cours et le contenu AP est évalué par un examen normalisé chaque mai. Markville offre AP Calculus, Chemistry, Microeconomics, European History, English et Geography (World Issues); les élèves remplissent un AP Application Form disponible en orientation.

note.en: Specialist High Skills Major for Grades 11-12 in Arts and Culture, Business, Environment, Health and Wellness and Information Communication Technology: a bundle of sector courses, certifications, experiential learning and co-op.
note.es: Specialist High Skills Major para 11.º y 12.º grado en Arts and Culture, Business, Environment, Health and Wellness and Information Communication Technology: un conjunto de cursos del sector, certificaciones, aprendizaje experiencial y educación cooperativa.
note.fr: Specialist High Skills Major pour la 11e et la 12e année en Arts and Culture, Business, Environment, Health and Wellness and Information Communication Technology : un ensemble de cours sectoriels, des certifications, de l'apprentissage expérientiel et de l'éducation coopérative.

note.en: Exploring Opportunities Program: a regional program combining in-school learning with work-based experience, with a focus on entrepreneurship (Flash Print @ MSS print and design business).
note.es: Exploring Opportunities Program: un programa regional que combina aprendizaje en la escuela con experiencia laboral, con enfoque en emprendimiento (negocio de impresión y diseño Flash Print @ MSS).
note.fr: Exploring Opportunities Program : un programme régional qui combine l'apprentissage à l'école et l'expérience en milieu de travail, axé sur l'entrepreneuriat (entreprise d'impression et de design Flash Print @ MSS).

note.en: High Performance Athlete (HPA) gives timetable support to students who compete at the provincial, national or international level in eligible sports.
note.es: High Performance Athlete (HPA) ofrece apoyo de horario a estudiantes que compiten a nivel provincial, nacional o internacional en deportes elegibles.
note.fr: High Performance Athlete (HPA) offre un soutien d'horaire aux élèves qui participent à des compétitions de niveau provincial, national ou international dans des sports admissibles.
